goal: Add separate collision-safe scalp, grouped-tip and soft hairline layers without changing the validated dynamic card topology.

iterations.evidence: Rigid head weighting without the body parent transform displaced the scalp shell during yaw.
All 759 scalp vertices received normalized source weights, but the missing rig parent still caused 31.9mm dynamic mismatch.
Matching the body parent fixed dynamic drift; one ambiguous open-boundary vertex remained negative.
Removing the four boundary faces gave 758/758 scalp points positive clearance, while premature tip shortening moved card point 16 into the body.
Restoring card points 15-17 recovered zero penetration and 5.058mm P95 motion; grouped shortening begins at the true tip region.
32 projected hairline cards kept 1.389mm clearance but dense alpha read as forehead spikes.
Low-opacity owned alpha softened the transition layer without geometry or collision changes.
Matte zero-specular scalp material recedes behind cards; dynamic, material and three-layer clearance audits pass.

next: Replace tiled crown rows with offset overlapping undercards and sculpt asymmetric outer locks while preserving the r287 layer and motion gates.
